$comment: The cases every reader of 'is this picture the slide's placed photo?' must answer alike. The rule is one kernel, lib/core/placed-picture.mjs; its readers are the engine and Export-to-Marp (test/unit/plugins/image-address.test.js), Compose's badge and the Studio's photo finder `photoAt` (docs/src/lib/compose/placed-picture-parity.test.ts), and the image lint. `addr` is the picture in question; `placed` is the engine's answer, which the others must match. `crowded`: the image lint's `image-extra-panel` flags this picture (several lone pictures and no other photo, so none is placed); every other case it leaves alone. A case that depends on a `<!-- class: … -->` or a `backgroundImage` carried from the front matter or an earlier slide runs through every reader too: the Studio reads the carries from the whole deck (lib/core/slide-carried.mjs, docs/src/lib/slide-carried.ts; Compose from its document). PR #3126, followups.d/3126-p2-one-placed-picture-rule.md.
